comment: pickup.c tipcontainer_gettarget() preselects 'on the floor'. Clearing that row and committing (select_menu() returns 0) leaves otmp 0 and *cancelled FALSE, so tipcontainer() tips onto the floor; only ESC (n == -1) cancels. A debug Wizard wishes for two sacks, tips the first (p) with #tip, clears the floor row with '\\' (MENU_UNSELECT_PAGE; the row's own selector '-' would choose it explicitly) and commits with Return. The second sack is the carried target that makes the menu appear.
